name: Premier Group Limited
summary: Premier Group Limited operates as a consumer packaged goods company in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Millbake, and Groceries and International segments. The company offers sugar-based confectionery products; meal solutions, including ready meals, pies and pastry-based, dairy, fruit juices; and food products, such as jams, fruits, salads, vegetables, meat, and dry packaged foods; and wheat flour, maize meal, pasta, biscuits, and animal feeds products. It also provides animal feeds, feminine hygiene, skincare, and other personal care products that include intimate care, menstrual, and cotton wool products.
